description: Install Django REST Framework and configure API base
steps: Add djangorestframework and django-filter to project dependencies in pyproject.toml
Run `uv sync --dev` and verify packages install correctly
Add 'rest_framework' and 'django_filters' to INSTALLED_APPS in config/settings.py
Configure DEFAULT_PERMISSION_CLASSES to IsAuthenticated in REST_FRAMEWORK settings
Configure DEFAULT_FILTER_BACKENDS with DjangoFilterBackend
Add api/ URL namespace to config/urls.py
Run `uv run python manage.py check` and verify it passes

description: Install HTMX + DaisyUI and configure template infrastructure
steps: Add django-htmx to project dependencies in pyproject.toml
Run `uv sync --dev` and verify package installs correctly
Add 'django_htmx' to INSTALLED_APPS and HtmxMiddleware to MIDDLEWARE
Create templates/ directory at project root and configure TEMPLATES DIRS in settings
Create base.html with: Tailwind CSS CDN, DaisyUI CDN plugin, HTMX CDN script, block structure (content, title, extra_css, extra_js), DaisyUI theme data-theme attribute
Create base_user.html extending base.html with DaisyUI navbar component (Spaces, My Reservations, Logout), DaisyUI drawer for mobile
Create base_admin.html extending base.html with DaisyUI navbar + drawer sidebar (Dashboard, Spaces, Reservations, Maintenance)
Create partials/_messages.html template using DaisyUI alert and toast components for Django messages framework
Configure STATIC_URL and STATICFILES_DIRS in settings
Verify Tailwind + DaisyUI classes render correctly in browser
Verify HTMX requests work (test with a simple hx-get partial swap)
Run `uv run python manage.py check` and verify it passes

description: Create accounts app with authentication views
steps: Create Django app 'accounts' and add to INSTALLED_APPS
Create login view and template at /accounts/login/ using DaisyUI card as form container, form-control for inputs, btn-primary for submit (centered hero layout)
Create registration view and template at /accounts/register/ (username, email, password) with same DaisyUI card layout
Create logout view at /accounts/logout/ (redirect to login)
Style form validation errors using DaisyUI input-error class and label-text-alt for error messages
Configure LOGIN_URL, LOGIN_REDIRECT_URL, LOGOUT_REDIRECT_URL in settings
Register accounts URLs in config/urls.py
Write tests: login page renders (200)
Write tests: valid registration creates user and redirects
Write tests: login with valid credentials authenticates and redirects
Write tests: protected page redirects unauthenticated user to login
Run `uv run pytest` and verify tests pass with >= 80% coverage

description: Create spaces app with Space and Attribute models
steps: Create Django app 'spaces' and add to INSTALLED_APPS

Define Space model with fields: name (CharField), description (TextField nullable), capacity (PositiveIntegerField), location (CharField), is_active (BooleanField default=True), created_at, updated_at
Define Attribute model with fields: name (CharField unique)
Define SpaceAttribute M2M through model with space FK and attribute FK
Add __str__ methods to all models
Create and apply migrations
Enable btree_gist extension via migration (needed for future exclusion constraint)
Run `uv run python manage.py check` and verify it passes
Run `uv run pytest` and verify tests pass

description: Create reservations app with Reservation model and state machine
steps: Create Django app 'reservations' and add to INSTALLED_APPS
Define ReservationStatus choices: confirmed, cancelled, checked_in, completed, no_show

Define Reservation model with fields: space (FK), user (FK to auth.User), start_time (DateTimeField), end_time (DateTimeField), status (CharField with choices, default=confirmed), checked_in_at (DateTimeField nullable), created_at, updated_at
Add ExclusionConstraint using btree_gist to prevent overlapping reservations for the same space (only for non-cancelled statuses)
Define MaintenanceBlock model with fields: space (FK), start_time, end_time, reason (CharField), created_by (FK to auth.User)
Add __str__ methods and Meta ordering
Create and apply migrations
Run `uv run python manage.py check` and verify it passes
Run `uv run pytest` and verify tests pass

description: Implement Space API with attribute-based filtering
steps: Create SpaceSerializer and AttributeSerializer in spaces/serializers.py
Create SpaceViewSet with list, retrieve, create, update actions
Create SpaceFilterSet with filters: min_capacity, max_capacity, attributes (by name), is_active, location
Register Space URLs in spaces/urls.py using DRF router
Include spaces URLs in config/urls.py under api/ prefix
Verify GET /api/spaces/ returns list of spaces
Verify GET /api/spaces/?min_capacity=5&attributes=TV filters correctly
Verify admin can POST /api/spaces/ to create a space
Run `uv run pytest` and verify tests pass with >= 80% coverage

description: Implement real-time availability check for spaces
steps: Create availability service function: check_availability(space_id, date) returns list of available time slots
Service must consider existing confirmed/checked_in reservations AND maintenance blocks
Create availability endpoint: GET /api/spaces/{id}/availability/?date=YYYY-MM-DD
Endpoint returns list of occupied slots and free slots for the given date
Write tests: availability reflects existing reservations correctly
Write tests: availability reflects maintenance blocks correctly
Write tests: cancelled reservations do NOT block availability
Run `uv run pytest` and verify tests pass with >= 80% coverage

description: Implement reservation creation with conflict validation
steps: Create ReservationSerializer in reservations/serializers.py with validation
Create reservation service: create_reservation(user, space, start_time, end_time) with conflict check
Service must validate: space is_active, no overlapping confirmed/checked_in reservations, no overlapping maintenance blocks, end_time > start_time
Create ReservationViewSet with create action (POST /api/reservations/)
Automatically set user from request.user and status to 'confirmed'
Register reservation URLs and include in config/urls.py
Write tests: successful reservation creation
Write tests: conflict returns 409 or 400 with clear error message
Write tests: reservation on inactive space is rejected
Run `uv run pytest` and verify tests pass with >= 80% coverage

description: Implement self-service cancellation and rescheduling
steps: Add cancel action to ReservationViewSet: PATCH /api/reservations/{id}/cancel/
Cancel service: only reservation owner can cancel, only confirmed/checked_in status can be cancelled
Add reschedule action: PATCH /api/reservations/{id}/reschedule/ with new start_time and end_time
Reschedule service: validates new slot availability, updates times, keeps status confirmed
Write tests: owner can cancel their own reservation
Write tests: non-owner cannot cancel another user's reservation (403)
Write tests: cannot cancel already cancelled reservation
Write tests: reschedule to conflicting slot is rejected
Write tests: successful reschedule updates times and slot becomes available
Run `uv run pytest` and verify tests pass with >= 80% coverage

description: Implement check-in mechanism
steps: Add check-in action to ReservationViewSet: POST /api/reservations/{id}/check-in/
Check-in service: validates reservation is 'confirmed', current time is within reservation window (or up to 15 min before start), sets status to 'checked_in' and checked_in_at timestamp
Only reservation owner can check-in
Write tests: successful check-in within valid time window
Write tests: check-in before valid window is rejected
Write tests: check-in on non-confirmed reservation is rejected
Write tests: check-in by non-owner is rejected (403)
Run `uv run pytest` and verify tests pass with >= 80% coverage

description: Implement auto-release of no-show reservations
steps: Create service function: auto_release_no_shows(threshold_minutes=15) that marks overdue reservations as 'no_show'
Service finds all 'confirmed' reservations where start_time + threshold < now and no check-in
Service sets status to 'no_show' for each matching reservation
Service returns count of released reservations
Create management command: release_no_shows (with optional --threshold argument)
Write tests: reservation past threshold without check-in is marked no_show
Write tests: reservation within threshold is NOT marked no_show
Write tests: checked_in reservation is NOT affected
Write tests: already cancelled reservation is NOT affected
Run `uv run pytest` and verify tests pass with >= 80% coverage

description: Implement admin maintenance blocks
steps: Create MaintenanceBlockSerializer in reservations/serializers.py
Create MaintenanceBlockViewSet with create, list, delete actions (admin only)
Validate that maintenance block does not overlap with existing confirmed reservations
Register endpoint: POST /api/admin/maintenance-blocks/
Add IsAdminUser permission to admin endpoints
Write tests: admin can create maintenance block on free slot
Write tests: non-admin cannot create maintenance block (403)
Write tests: maintenance block overlapping existing reservation is rejected
Write tests: maintenance block appears in availability check
Run `uv run pytest` and verify tests pass with >= 80% coverage

description: Implement admin occupancy overview endpoint
steps: Create endpoint: GET /api/admin/occupancy/?date=YYYY-MM-DD
Returns all spaces with their reservations and maintenance blocks for the given date
Include reservation status in response to distinguish confirmed vs checked_in vs no_show

description: Implement user reservation listing with filtering
steps: Add list action to ReservationViewSet: GET /api/reservations/
Filter by authenticated user (users see only their own reservations)
Add filters: status, space, date range (start_time__gte, start_time__lte)
Order by start_time descending (most recent first)
Write tests: user sees only their own reservations
Write tests: filters work correctly (by status, by date range)

description: Create seed_data management command with modular seed infrastructure
steps: Create core/management/commands/ directory structure with __init__.py files
Create core/seeds/ package with __init__.py and separate modules: attributes.py, spaces.py, users.py, reservations.py, maintenance.py
Create management command seed_data that orchestrates all seed modules in order (attributes → spaces → users → reservations → maintenance)
Each seed module exposes a seed() function that uses get_or_create for idempotency
Add optional --flush flag that removes seed-identifiable records (by natural keys) before re-seeding
Run `uv run python manage.py seed_data --help` and verify command is registered
Run `uv run python manage.py check` and verify it passes

description: Seed default attributes in Portuguese (pt-BR)

Use get_or_create keyed by Attribute.name for idempotency
Write test: seed creates all 7 attributes
Write test: running seed twice does not duplicate attributes
Verify all attribute names are in pt-BR
Run `uv run pytest` and verify tests pass with >= 80% coverage

Associate attributes per PRD spec (Alfa: AC+TV+Videoconferência+Wi-Fi, Beta: AC+Projetor+Quadro branco+Wi-Fi, Focus: AC+Webcam+Wi-Fi, Auditório: AC+Projetor+TV+Videoconferência+Wi-Fi, Executiva: AC+TV+Webcam+Videoconferência+Wi-Fi)

description: Seed sample reservations and maintenance blocks in Portuguese (pt-BR)
steps: Implement core/seeds/reservations.py with seed() function creating 4 demo scenarios: maria.silva future confirmed on Sala de Reunião Alfa, joao.santos past completed on Sala Focus, ana.costa today confirmed on Sala Executiva (check-in window), joao.santos past no_show on Sala de Reunião Beta
